definition: traveling a long way from one place to another
description: A girl crosses the city step by step: she grabs a croissant and coffee, walks wet streets, swipes through the subway turnstile, rides the train, fights with a broken umbrella in the rain and climbs long stairs until she reaches a rooftop view at sunset and says it was worth it.
transcript: Gotta eat something first or I seriously won't make it. I really hope this is the right train. Okay, looks right. Of course it's raining. Almost there. But it was worth it.
